config_schema.title: Daily News & Content Discovery Service Config

fields.label: NewsNow Upstream Base URL
fields.description: Upstream NewsNow feed service base URL

fields.label: Freshness Window (Hours)
fields.description: Maximum age of news articles in hours to consider fresh

fields.label: Max Age (Days)
fields.description: Sliding window for tiered content discovery

fields.label: Require Latest Breaking News
fields.description: Prioritize latest breaking news with verified publication timestamps

fields.label: Default Feeds/Sources
fields.description: Comma-separated list of feed sources to query

fields.label: Enable Native Reddit Feed
fields.description: Enable native Reddit ingestion directly without external service

fields.label: Reddit Subreddits
fields.description: Comma-separated list of subreddits to monitor

fields.label: Reddit API Client ID
fields.description: Reddit API Script app client ID for authenticated access

fields.label: Reddit API Client Secret
fields.description: Reddit API Script app client secret for authenticated access

fields.label: Enable Redis Ingestion
fields.description: Enable ingesting articles directly from Redis Stream or List

fields.label: Redis Server URL
fields.description: Redis connection URL with host, port, and database index

fields.label: Redis Target Key
fields.description: Redis Stream key or List key to consume

fields.label: Redis Structure Type
fields.description: Redis data structure: stream (XREVRANGE) or list (LRANGE)
